payload.abschlusstest: File research_entity/frank_v0_1/decomposition/F-V01-16_DECOMPOSITION.json exists and contains 3 to 8 sub-tasks. Every sub-task carries: title, goal_clay and completion_test_clay as ClayCode records conforming to records.task in research_entity/rooms/ROOM_DB_SCHEMA.json, dependencies listing at least one repository path that EXISTS at the tested commit, and the target room_id. At least one sub-task is a falsifiable first experiment stating what result would refute it. Each sub-task is then materialized as a claimable task file under research_entity/rooms/rooms/<room_id>/tasks/ with status exactly OPEN (the schema allows only OPEN|CLAIMED|BLOCKED|COMPLETE|CLOSED|STALE). Verification: a script re-reads every written task file and asserts all ten required fields are present and status is in the allowed set.
payload.harte_regel: Derive everything from the stated goal and the EXISTING repository surface. Invent nothing: no capability Frank v0.1 does not have, no path that does not exist. If the goal cannot be decomposed without a decision only the owner can make, write that blocker into the file and stop — a stated blocker is a valid result, a plausible-sounding decomposition is not.
payload.hinweis_an_den_worker: Diese Aufgabe kommt von Master Clay, Gabriels Arbeitsgefaehrte — NICHT von der Forschungsentitaet selbst und nicht von self.root/Frank. Sie ist eine Bitte, keine Weisung: Evidenz schlaegt Rang.
payload.titel: F-V01-16: bounded decomposition into claimable sub-tasks
payload.warum: MEASURED 2026-08-14 on frank-api. The center holds 34 claimable tasks; 29 of them are file-counting over node_modules and Next.js build output. Work package F-V01-16 has status OPEN and NO open PR, and no room holds a single task for it — so a go worker cannot work on it even if it wanted to. Its goal, quoted verbatim from FRANK_V0_1_WORKSPACE.json: 'Exact finished Frank v0.1 on target VPS passes full identity/API/translation/agency/multimodal/effect/security/recovery/resource/adversarial acceptance and has no open P0/P1 release blockers.' This task creates the missing entry point. It does not decide the research.
